name: Mágocs (Hungary)
description: White field with three chevron-shaped vertical stripes of red, yellow and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Mágocs (a quartered shield of red and white with roses, a church and a bunch of grapes) above a yellow scroll inscribed MÁGOCS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
